name: Mary, Queen of Scots
contribution: Queen of Scotland from 14 December 1542 until her forced abdication on 24 July 1567.

checks.lead: Mary, Queen of Scots (8 December 1542 – 8 February 1587), also known as Mary Stuart or Mary I of Scotland, was Queen of Scotland from 14 December 1542 until her forced abdication on 24 July 1567.
